title: Sales leaves a no-charge line out of revenue, cost and invoiced hours
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Open Reports > Sales, set the date range to today and note its revenue, parts cost and invoiced hours.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today, billable, invoiced after the figures were noted, with line 1 of 2.0 hours at $120.00 an hour ($240.00) and line 2 of 1.5 hours marked No Charge under Goodwill with one stock part costing $40.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports > Sales.
  2. Set the date range to today.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Sales opens.

Step 2:

  • Revenue is the noted figure plus $240.00: line 2 adds $0.00.
  • Parts cost is the noted figure: line 2's $40.00 is left out.
  • Invoiced hours are the noted figure plus 2.0: line 2's 1.5 hours are left out.
  • Work order 1 is listed with its billable amounts.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11766 (Story 9, Reports, dashboard and exports), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S9-R1: “Sales, Sales By Customer, Sales By Representative and Advisor Analysis leave whole internal and no-charge work orders out of every number, with no filter and no option to include them. On a billable work order they leave every no-charge line out of labor revenue, parts revenue, labor cost, parts cost, invoiced hours and worked hours, the way a declined line is left out today: the invoice financial snapshot captures the no-charge lines as excluded, and the per-statement queries carry the same condition. The work order itself stays in with its billable amounts. Every dashboard card and ranking (Sales, Sales by Customer, Top Customers with its invoice count, At-Risk Customers, Billing, and the Invoices card, "Total invoices in range") does the same. The dashboard Tech Efficiency card follows the Technician Efficiency report's default (Show all, S9-R3), so the card and the report give the same hours for a technician.”
  • S12-R11: “Reports and the dashboard follow Story 9 (S9-R1, S9-R2, S9-R3, S9-R7, S9-R8, S9-R11 to S9-R13); the Open API follows Story 11; the hub record follows S8-R7.”
  • Key Decisions: “A no-charge line stays on its billable work order and shows $0.00 on one invoice, instead of moving to a separate work order. One work order, one classification, one document still holds for whole internal and no-charge work orders; the line case is the exception and is handled line by line in the invoice, the posting and every report.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
